policy: No prohibited transcription source may be used. Official NTA/CBSE papers and final keys are the authority. Approved independent archives may only recover or cross-check missing text. Every retained item must be independently solved, chapter-tagged, rated 0-10, and supplied with a clean redraw when needed. Ambiguous, dropped, bonus, unreadable, watermarked, and answer-mismatched items are quarantined.
